# Oxford Realty Advisors

> Private family-office industrial real estate investor. 100% proprietary capital — no outside LPs, no fund life to manage around. Acquires $1M-$10M Class B/C shallow-bay industrial and flex properties across DC Metro/Baltimore, Columbus OH, Indianapolis, and Kansas City, with active expansion into additional Midwest secondary markets.
